description: How long to roast a turkey by weight: cooking time, oven temperature, resting time and the temperature it must reach. Covers a whole turkey, a crown (breast on the bone) or a boneless breast joint, with UK (British Turkey, 190°C) or US (USDA, 325°F) times. Give a serving time to get when it goes in the oven.

cut.description: whole (default), crown, or breast for a boneless joint or roll.

method.description: uk: 190°C (170°C fan), 375°F. usda: 325°F (165°C). Defaults to usda when the weight is in lb, otherwise uk.

serve_time.description: Optional serving time as HH:MM in 24-hour time, e.g. 14:00. When given, the answer says when it goes in the oven.

stuffed.description: A whole bird stuffed in the cavity (USDA times only; for UK times, weigh it with the stuffing).

weight.description: Weight of the meat, in the unit given by unit.

name: turkey_cooking_time
title: Turkey cooking time
